items.title: Nifty bulls regain momentum, but can bears strike back? 5 factors to decide D-Street’s fate next week
items.description: Indian equities snapped an eight-week losing streak as the Nifty 50 and Sensex rebounded on Friday. However, elevated crude prices, foreign investor outflows, inflation data, bond yields and the September-quarter earnings season could shape the market’s next move. Here are five key factors investors should track next week.

items.title: IT stocks surge despite US immigration curbs
items.description: On Friday, Indian IT stocks experienced an impressive surge, spearheaded by a remarkable 4.2% jump in Tata Consultancy Services shares. This unexpected rally took analysts by surprise, as it unfolded amidst ongoing concerns surrounding US regulations impacting technology firms. Additionally, OpenAI’s updated revenue projections alleviated fears regarding potential disruptions from AI on traditional IT services.

items.title: Sebi notifies new settlement rule; unveils formula, fast-track route. Check details
items.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has rolled out fresh regulations that modify how settlement amounts for securities violations are calculated. This revamped formula curtails the double counting of unjust gains in settlement assessments. Moreover, it introduces a fast-track process for cases where settlement amounts are less than ₹10 lakh, aiming for quicker resolutions while ensuring regulatory efficiency in handling securities issues.

items.title: D-Street breaks 8-week losing run, outlook stays cautious though
items.description: After an eight-week slump, Indian equities experienced a robust rebound, highlighted by a notable rise in the BSE Sensex. This recovery was buoyed by declining crude oil prices, which eased from their recent peaks. While foreign portfolio investors remained in a selling mood, local institutional investors stepped in with strong buying activity.

items.title: Adani Green Energy H1 Update: Operational capacity rises 24% YoY to 20,763 MW, energy sales jump 32%
items.description: Adani Green Energy reported a 24% year-on-year rise in operational capacity to 20,763 MW in H1FY27, while energy sales jumped 32% to 25,747 million units. The company added 4,083 MW of greenfield capacity and expanded its battery storage portfolio. Its board will consider Q2FY27 financial results on October 21.

items.title: FIIs dump Indian stocks for eight straight weeks: Is a reversal on the cards or more pain ahead?
items.description: FIIs sold Indian equities for an eighth consecutive week, offloading Rs 30,294 crore, while DIIs bought Rs 30,313 crore to cushion the outflows. The Nifty 50 ended marginally higher, snapping its losing streak. Elevated crude oil prices, rupee weakness and global bond yields remain key factors shaping the outlook for a sustained recovery.

items.title: 8 midcap stocks rally up to 135% in a year; 2 turn multibaggers
items.description: Over the past year, the benchmark Nifty has remained largely flat, while the Nifty Midcap 150 index has gained around 11%. Within the midcap universe, 32 stocks have delivered double-digit returns. We spotlight eight standout performers that have surged anywhere between 50%-135% over the past year, including two multibaggers that have more than doubled investors’ wealth. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: Concurrent Gainers: 14 smallcap stocks that gain for 5 days in a row
items.description: Over the five trading sessions from October 5 to 9, the Sensex gained 0.78%, or 563 points, to close at 72,472. The benchmark index ended in the red in two of the five sessions. Despite the modest gains in the broader market, 15 smallcap stocks recorded gains in each of the five trading sessions. (Data Source: ACE Equity)
